_source: Canonical dispute taxonomy (8 axes). Editorial copy; do not re-derive the axes.
visibility_rule: A1, A2, A6, A7, A8 are pre-moderated before publication; A3, A4, A5 publish immediately with a 'reply pending review' badge.

axes.name: Factual data error
axes.trigger: A specific number, date, fee, latency, or label is objectively wrong.
axes.required_evidence: Source ledger or explorer URL, timestamp, on-chain or PSP receipt, signed engineer statement.
axes.remedy: Inline correction plus a dated note; recompute affected rankings.

axes.name: Methodology bug (code or sampling)
axes.trigger: A published formula or sampler has a defect (off-by-one, unit error, biased window).
axes.required_evidence: Pointer to the commit or line in the open-source benchmark repo, plus a reproducible counter-run.
axes.remedy: Patch, re-run, and republish with a changelog; the original is archived with strikethrough.

axes.name: Methodology fairness or framing
axes.trigger: Metric selection, weighting, a missing confidence interval, or chart framing materially mischaracterises (an opinion, not a bug).
axes.required_evidence: An argument plus at least one alternative metric with its computation.
axes.remedy: A published rebuttal alongside the chart, plus an editorial note; no obligation to alter the ranking.

axes.name: Performance changed since measurement
axes.trigger: The rail was patched or upgraded after the measurement window.
axes.required_evidence: Release-notes URL, deploy timestamp, signed re-measurement request.
axes.remedy: Re-benchmark next cycle; a 'patched on [date]' badge on the historical row.

axes.name: Scope objection (testnet or sandbox vs production)
axes.trigger: The operator tested an environment unrepresentative of production.
axes.required_evidence: Endpoint URLs, network IDs, SDK version diff.
axes.remedy: Relabel as a scoped result, or rerun on production endpoints.

axes.name: Mischaracterisation or attribution
axes.trigger: A claim attributed to or implied of the rail was not made by the rail (for example an SLA or a compliance claim).
axes.required_evidence: The original rail-published statement (URL or PDF), plus the operator quote being challenged.
axes.remedy: Edit the attribution; a published apology note if defamatory.

axes.name: Confidentiality or NDA
axes.trigger: The underlying datum is contractually confidential (for example an enterprise-tier rate).
axes.required_evidence: Reference to the NDA clause plus the rail's confidentiality-officer attestation.
axes.remedy: Either redact and label 'withheld at the rail's request', or retain with a disclaimer that the rail asserts an NDA. The operator never acknowledges the contents of any NDA it has not signed.

axes.name: Jurisdictional or compliance
axes.trigger: Publication risks breaching an EU, UK, or US rule (PSD2 SCA mischaracterisation, MiCA, OFAC, FCA Principle 7).
axes.remedy: A targeted geo-fence of the disputed claim, or a footnoted regulatory caveat; escalate to the operator's legal function.
